# BLO-49139: remove the adapter's SIGTERM listener

Tracking: [BLO-49139](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/BLO/issues/BLO-49139)

`ensureSigtermHandler()` installed a `process.once("SIGTERM")` listener the first time `execute()` ran. On a rolling deploy it **deleted every active Job and its Secrets** and then called `process.exit(0)`. That killed the host's graceful drain, and it tore down live agent work that the next replica should have reattached. claude_k8s dropped the same behaviour under FAR-107.

The listener is deleted, together with the `activeJobs` map whose only reader it was. Shutdown belongs to the host. The two tests that pinned the old behaviour are replaced by one that asserts `execute()` adds no SIGTERM/SIGINT listener. That test was checked to fail against the old source.

Version: `0.2.8-blockcast.1` → `0.2.8-blockcast.2`.
